description: Electricity generation by source (TWh), by continent, 2000 onward. Radio buttons select which continent's stacked area chart is shown (default: North America). Style reference: Vega stacked area chart example (https://vega.github.io/vega/examples/stacked-area-chart/). Data: Our World in Data, 'Electricity production by source' (https://ourworldindata.org/grapher/electricity-prod-source-stacked).
